title: Amyloid dye-binding analysis of α-synuclein fibrils
author: Arpine Sokratian

steps.title: Prepare dye powders
steps.instruction: Obtain Nile Red (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #19123-10MG), NIAD‑4 (Caymanchem, Catalog #18520), Thioflavin T (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #T3516) and FSB (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #344101-5MG) and bring the powders to room temperature.

steps.title: Dissolve dyes and store aliquots
steps.instruction: Dissolve NIAD‑4, Nile Red and FSB in DMSO to a final concentration of 15 mM each; dissolve Thioflavin T in ddH₂O to a final concentration of 1 mM. Aliquot the solutions and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare sonicated fibrils
steps.instruction: Follow the established protocol to generate a batch of sonicated mouse or human α‑synuclein fibrils. If fibrils were prepared earlier and stored at –80 °C, thaw them in a water bath, then perform a quality‑control check to confirm size distribution and concentration match the reference values.

steps.title: Dilute fibrils to working concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute the evaluated sonicated fibrils in PBS to a concentration of 2 mg mL⁻¹ and prepare serial two‑fold dilutions in PBS as needed.

steps.title: Thaw dye aliquots
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen dye aliquots in a water bath set to 42 °C.

steps.title: Dilute dyes in PBS
steps.instruction: Dilute each dye in PBS to a final concentration of 100 µM, using 2–3 mL total volume per dye in 15 mL Falcon tubes. Perform this dilution only after all other reagents (fibrils, plates, etc.) are ready.

steps.title: Add dye to 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 µL of each 100 µM dye solution into the appropriate wells of a Corning 384‑well Black/Clear Bottom Low‑Flange Ultra‑Low Attachment Microplate (Catalog #4588). After adding the dye, spin down the covered plate before proceeding.

steps.title: Add fibrils to dye‑preloaded wells
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate volume of fibril or protein sample to each dye‑preloaded well. Include a standard curve using either BSA fibrils or recombinant sonicated α‑synuclein fibrils (starting from 5 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Seal and spin plate
steps.instruction: Cover the plate with sealing foil and spin down at 500 g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Configure microplate reader
steps.instruction: Program the BMG Labtech CLARIOstar reader: incubate for 5 min with continuous shaking at 200 rpm, then record fluorescence using the following settings – FSB: excitation 468 ± 15 nm / emission 510 ± 20 nm; Nile Red: excitation 535 ± 20 nm / emission 585 ± 30 nm; ThT: excitation 448 ± 10 nm / emission 482 ± 10 nm.

steps.title: Include controls and blanks
steps.instruction: Run monomeric mouse and human α‑synuclein as controls and include a blank well containing PBS only.

steps.title: Analyze fluorescence data
steps.instruction: Subtract the average blank fluorescence from each well, then correlate the adjusted values with the standard curve, ensuring that all extrapolated values fall within the appropriate range of the curve.
